parameters.subject: =Application Update –  {{ $json.job }}
parameters.message:
=Dear {{ $json.Candidate }},

Thank you for applying for the {{ $json.job }} position.

We are pleased to inform you that your application has been shortlisted for the next stage of the recruitment process.

Your evaluation score: {{ $json.Score }}/100

Matching Skills:
{{ $json["Matching Skills"] }}

Our recruitment team will contact you with the next steps.

Best regards,
HR Team

parameters.text:
=You are an expert technical interviewer.

Generate 8 interview questions for the following candidate.

Candidate Name:
{{ $json["Candidate"] }}

Job Title:
{{ $json["job"] }}

Experience:
{{ $json["Experience"] }} years

Matching Skills:
{{ $json["Matching Skills"] }}

Missing Skills:
{{ $json["Missing Skills"] }}

AI Assessment:
{{ $json["AI Concerns"] }}

The candidate has been accepted by HR.

Requirements:

1. Generate exactly 8 interview questions.
2. Questions must be relevant to the job.
3. Focus on the candidate's actual skills.
4. Include technical questions.
5. Include practical/problem-solving questions.
6. Include at least one behavioral question.
7. If the candidate is missing an important required skill, include a question that evaluates that skill.
8. Do not invent experience or skills.
9. Do not provide answers.
10. Return only the interview questions.

parameters.subject: Application Update – Backend Developer
parameters.message:
=Dear {{ $json.Candidate }},

Thank you for your interest in the {{ $json.job }} position.

After reviewing your application, we are sorry to inform you that your application was not selected to proceed to the next stage.

Reason:
{{ $json["HR Notes"] }}

Missing Skills:
{{ $json["Missing Skills"] }}

We appreciate your time and interest in our company and wish you success in your future opportunities.

Best regards,
HR Team
